classifications.producer: Named audit, benchmark, model, and evidence commands
classifications.reason: Tracked historical benchmark, browser, pixel, model, and receipt outputs are generated evidence; source and activation authority stays in manifests and verifiers.
Ignored hosting collections are disposable packages assembled from canonical public sources and are never edited as runtime source.
This inventory is a generated reference over independently governed artifact manifests and hashes.
The connected plugin runtime registry is generated from validated plugin manifests in stable plugin-id order.
Model trial predictions, frontiers, and opening receipts are generated evidence bound to committed populations and policies.
Policy-arena evidence is generated from declared sources, populations, budgets, and deterministic trial configuration.
The component index is generated from recursively discovered CATSCAN charters and their validated local links.
The project-local contract is an exact generated mirror of the Ouroboros catalog authority for standalone validation.
The project-local schema is an exact generated mirror of the shared Ouroboros folder-contract schema.
The project-local deterministic checker is synchronized byte-for-byte from the shared Ouroboros implementation.
